coverage_note: All 231 modern catalog idols retain their recorded colors: 190 Cinderella Girls, 28 Shiny Colors and 13 Gakuen idols. All 61 groups are covered: seven Shiny Colors units retain community image colors; the three franchise ensembles Shiny Colors, Cinderella Girls and Hatsuboshi Gakuen use official-site brand display accents instead of full-roster gradients; the remaining 51 units use verified member palettes. Explicit colors take priority. Brand display accents and community image colors are not claimed as official group HEX standards. Team.Stella/Luna/Sol retain the official September 2026 HOPEFUL FE@THERS lineups. REFRAC7IONS groups retain the union of announced December 2026 lineups. Stored rosters are not song-specific performer lists; members refer to canonical idols, not nested groups.
